cohort: Pregnant individuals with breech presentation who delivered at Pokhara Academy of Health Sciences, Kaski, Nepal between Baishak and Chaitra of 2074 (Nepali calendar).
finding: Perinatal morbidity was higher in the cesarean breech delivery group compared to the vaginal breech delivery group, however the study suggests a larger sample size is needed to draw definitive conclusions.
mod_finding: Newborns delivered vaginally had significantly lower NICU admission rates (1.6% vs. 15.5%) and one neonatal death occurred in the vaginal delivery group.
